say:8:1620750006:0.text: I've made up my mind! I'm going to invite everyone on a date! But with so many people, where should we go?

say:10:1620750008:0.text: Oh, let's go to the garden. We can picnic beneath the flowering trees and try everyone's homemade dishes!
say:10:1620750008:0.source_cn: ……去花园吧！大家一起在馥郁的花树下野餐，品尝彼此精心...

say:11:1620750009:0.text: Oh, let's go to the fields. We can hop on magic carpets and fly through the sky together!
